title: MealEstimate
description: An itemized estimate of one plate. Every dish, bread, rice, side and the cooking fat is its own line.

name.description: Dish or item, e.g. "Phulka roti", "Ghee in tadka"

portion.description: Human portion, e.g. "2 medium", "1 katori", "1 tsp"

grams.description: Edible weight of this line in grams

myFoodId.description: The id of the matching saved food from the system prompt, else null

referenceId.description: The id returned by the search_food lookup tool when its values were used, else null

questions.description: At most two short questions, only when confidence is low on something that changes calories a lot

text.description: e.g. "Ghee or oil in the tadka?"
